base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y cmake ninja-build gcc g++ pkg-config libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libfreetype6-dev ruby-dev git curl python3 python3-pip

runtime_profile.notes: LVGL uses CMake with Ninja generator. Tests are run via Python script main.py. No virtual environment needed - system-level toolchain is sufficient.

notes: LVGL is a C graphics library built with CMake/Ninja. The fix.patch modifies GIF image descriptor initialization in src/libs/gif/lv_gif.c and lv_gif.h. System-level installation is appropriate - no language runtime activation needed. git and curl are explicitly included in system_packages.
